items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Levi Madison was a cat that we all loved so much... We used to sometimes check out lunches and go over to his apartment... Levi played with them [Heim mouthpieces].

ctx.x: Bascomb, yeah. Dud Bascomb and Shorty Baker, Levi Madison. We had some good players.
I want to ask you about Shorty Baker. Did you know him in St. Louis?
